			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_dispute_active

			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_selected
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_programme
	}

	else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_programme }

			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }

		army_experience = 15
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_service_procurement_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_service_procurement_awaiting_funding

	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.008 }

		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_accountability_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_transfer_implemented has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_government_active }

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_accountability_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_accountability_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_retirement_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_retirement_selected
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_accountability_selected

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_accountability_granted

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_ioa_12 = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.005 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_12_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_military_government_active
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			has_country_leader = { name = "Dimitrios Ioannidis" ruling_only = yes }

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_political_power = 35
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_12_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_12_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_12_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_12_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_12_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pasok_12_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_kke_12_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_royal_12_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_12_selected
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_12_programme

			check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_current_electoral_mandate_verified
			OR = { has_country_leader = { name = "Panagiotis Kanellopoulos" ruling_only = yes } has_country_leader = { name = "Konstantinos Karamanlis" ruling_only = yes } }
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_2_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_3_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_2_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_3_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_2_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_2_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_3_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_3_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_2_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_3_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pasok_2_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pasok_3_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_kke_2_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_kke_3_programme

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_nd_7 = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.005 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_transfer_implemented has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_government_active }
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_current_electoral_mandate_verified
			OR = { has_country_leader = { name = "Panagiotis Kanellopoulos" ruling_only = yes } has_country_leader = { name = "Konstantinos Karamanlis" ruling_only = yes } }

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_7_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_7_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_7_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pasok_7_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_kke_7_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_royal_7_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_selected
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_7_awaiting_funding
	}

		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes

		}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_centre_18 = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.008 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_transfer_implemented has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_government_active }
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_current_electoral_mandate_verified
			has_country_leader = { name = "Georgios Mavros" ruling_only = yes }

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_18_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_ioa_18_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_nd_18_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_selected
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pasok_18_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_kke_18_programme
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_royal_18_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_selected
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_centre_18_awaiting_funding
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_economy_4 = {

	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.01 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_CAT_construction_bonus uses = 1 bonus = 0.25 category = CAT_construction }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_selected
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_selected
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_4_awaiting_funding
	}
}

		139 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE is_controlled_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_10_local_programme } } }
		142 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE is_controlled_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_10_local_programme } } }
		974 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE is_controlled_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_10_local_programme } } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_10_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_economy_10_awaiting_funding
	}

	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost = 0.01 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_granted }
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_CAT_command_and_control_equipment_bonus uses = 1 bonus = 0.25 category = CAT_command_and_control_equipment }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_programme
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_selected
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_selected
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_programme
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_awaiting_funding
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_complete_army_10 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_granted }
		}
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_army_10 = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_granted }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_army_10_awaiting_funding
		}
	}

			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_programme_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		navy_experience = 20
		add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_navy_4_CAT_submarines_bonus uses = 1 bonus = 0.25 category = CAT_submarines }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_navy_4_granted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_navy_4_awaiting_funding
	}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_send_pap_15 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_military_government_active has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_controlled_government_active }
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			has_country_leader = { name = "Georgios Papadopoulos" ruling_only = yes }

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_granted }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = ENG
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_accepted_ENG }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_live_ENG }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_pending_ENG
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_live_ENG days = 90 value = 1 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_refused_ENG
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_pap_15_timed_out_ENG
			ENG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GRE_TREE.101 days = 1 } }
		}

		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_pap_15 = yes
	}
}

			}

		}

		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_cyprus_2_offer_instance = CYP.COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_instance }

				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_cyprus_2_live_CYP }

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_cyprus_2_pending_CYP
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_cyprus_2_live_CYP days = 90 value = 1 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_cyprus_2_refused_CYP

			CYP = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GRE_TREE.122 days = 1 } }

				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_accepted_TUR }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_live_TUR }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_pending_TUR
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_live_TUR days = 90 value = 1 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_refused_TUR
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_timed_out_TUR
			TUR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_GRE_TREE.141 days = 1 } }
		}

		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_grant_aegean_6 = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_tree_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_tree_initialized }
		}
		load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_focus
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_tree_initialized
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_mandate_party = -1 }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_rule_by_decree
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_security_state
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_politicised_officers
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_european_censure
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_administrative_clientelism
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_growth_foundations
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_crown_in_exile
		139 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_uneven_regions } } }
		142 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_uneven_regions } } }
		974 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = GRE } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_uneven_regions } } }
	}
}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_current_electoral_mandate_verified

		if = {

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_mission_proposal_timed_out
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_crisis_diplomatic_status_recorded
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_2_pending_TUR
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_2_live_TUR }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_2_pending_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_2_timed_out_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_response_recorded
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_3_pending_TUR
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_3_live_TUR }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_3_pending_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_3_timed_out_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_response_recorded
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_5_pending_TUR
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_5_live_TUR }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_5_pending_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_5_timed_out_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_response_recorded
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_pending_TUR
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_live_TUR }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_pending_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_6_timed_out_TUR
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_aegean_response_recorded
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_live_ENG }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_timed_out_ENG
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_GRE_1970_record_elected_mandate = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GRE
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_elections = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_transfer_implemented has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_civilian_government_active }
			OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 } }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_current_electoral_mandate_verified
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_GRE_1970_mandate_party = ruling_party }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_election_term days = 1460 value = 1 }
		COLDWAR_GRE_1970_reconcile_programmes_effect = yes
	}
}
